hero_title: No Indian brand should grow alone.
hero_text: Zeroing is a community of Indian brands and the people behind them. We open doors for each other, and we keep an honest record of how work in this country actually gets done.

bands.title: The community
bands.text: Indian brands made with intent. One brand's customer finds another. One founder's supplier helps the next.

bands.title: Independent Society
bands.text: Our podcast. One person, one long honest conversation about what their working life in India actually looked like.

bands.title: The Other Details
bands.text: Our research lab. The money, the paperwork, the years nobody saw. Written down, with sources.
